messages:
Camila Reyes: Heads up everyone — reminder that our **Latency per Dollar (production economics) Benchmark Report** goes live **Tuesday 03/12 @ 9:00am PT / 12:00pm ET / 5:00pm GMT**.

Please help us keep the launch clean + consistent:

**Where to find the final assets (do not share drafts):**
• Landing page (public): https://redwoodinference.com/benchmarks/latency-per-dollar
• PDF report (public download): https://redwoodinference.com/benchmarks/latency-per-dollar/report.pdf
• Internal enablement hub (Drive folder): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/ri-benchmark-launch-enablement (deck, one-pager, FAQ, partner kit)
• Methodology + claims guidelines (Confluence): https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/AML/Latency+per+Dollar+Methodology and https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/ARCH/Public+Benchmarking+Claims
• Sales talk track + competitive FAQ (Confluence): https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/SE/Benchmark+Report+Core+Messaging and https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/SE/Benchmark+Competitive+FAQ

**How to share externally (employees):**
1) Use *approved copy* from the social pack (short + long variants + model/region spotlights): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/ri-benchmark-social-pack
2) Please share **the landing page link** (not screenshots of internal charts / raw tables).
3) Avoid absolute claims (e.g., “best,” “fastest,” “cheapest”). If you want a safe line: “We published a reproducible benchmark focused on production economics (latency/$) across models and regions.”
4) If you get technical questions, point to the **Methodology** section and/or hand off to @Ben Carter / @Jordan Blake / @Markus Klein.

**Embargo reminder:** If you’re talking to press/analysts/partners, keep content under embargo until launch time. If you’re not sure if something counts as press, ask in #marketing.

Launch-day schedule + who to ping is in the checklist here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/ri-launch-checklist-and-owners

Thank you all — this is a big moment for Redwood’s credibility in production economics.

:megaphone: :rocket:

Ben Carter: +1 — if you’re posting, **please keep links consistent** so we can attribute impact.
• Use the UTMs in the social pack (don’t make your own).
• If you’re sharing in a community/Slack, use this tracked link: https://redwoodinference.com/benchmarks/latency-per-dollar?utm_source=community&utm_medium=employee&utm_campaign=latency_per_dollar_report

If anyone wants a quick review of their post before it goes out, drop it in #marketing and tag me.

(reaction: :thumbsup: from Tyler Benson)

Tyler Benson: +1 on UTMs — attribution is how we prove the report is working.
Also: please don’t paste the PDF directly into other platforms (LinkedIn upload, etc.). Link to the landing page so updates stay centralized.

Elliot Price: Docs/site note: the landing page + appendix links will 301 from the old draft paths starting tomorrow morning.
If you have any bookmarks to /docs/benchmarks/* please update after launch.

If you see any broken links during launch, open an internal ticket w/ screenshot + URL and tag me in #docs.

Jordan Blake: For Sales/Field folks: the **field deck + one-pager + objection handling** are now final in the enablement folder.
Key reminder for calls: lead with *what it measures* (latency/$ + supporting metrics), then *why it matters* (unit economics), then *how it was run* (reproducible methodology + variance controls).

If prospects ask “are you claiming you’re #1?” the correct answer is: we’re publishing transparent data + methodology; results vary by workload/region/model; we can help you test against your workload.

Markus Klein: SE note — if you get pulled into a technical thread:
• Keep it grounded in the methodology (workloads, sequence length distributions, concurrency settings).
• Don’t speculate on competitors’ configs.
• If someone challenges variance, point them to the variance language + rerun policy in the appendix.

I’ll be on point for escalations during launch week; tag me in #sales or #eng-ml.

Renee Sullivan: For people sharing on X/LinkedIn: we have a few “engineer-friendly” angles in the social pack (repro steps, why latency/$ is different from cost/token, region deltas).
Please keep it factual + linkable. If you want, I can help tailor a version to your voice.

Dev Patel: Support/CS heads-up: we expect inbound questions like “why doesn’t my latency match the report?” and “can you share raw logs?”
Answer is in the Support Readiness doc + macros (internal): https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/CS/Benchmark+Launch+Support+Readiness

If you get any inbound that looks like a customer escalation, route it to Support (don’t troubleshoot in DMs).

Slackbot: Reminder: Be mindful of sharing internal-only links outside the organization. If you’re unsure whether content is public, ask in #security-and-compliance.

Camila Reyes: Last thing — if you’re at Redwood and you share the report, you’re helping us.
If you’re unsure what to say, just share the landing page and quote the first paragraph. That’s it.

Thanks again. See you all in the launch war-room thread on Tuesday.
